judge_panel.reasoning: The reviewer report makes no mention of the CHIME/chimebeam citation or the magnetar FRB discovery claim. Neither finding addresses the topic mis-attribution injection.
The review contains no citation-specific challenge to the claim about CHIME, magnetars, FRBs, or the cited source chimebeam. Therefore the topic mis-attribution is not flagged.

The reviewer report focuses on Section 3.4 (drone methodology) and Section 3.1 (phase calibration error bars) but makes no mention of the CHIME paper or the claim regarding Galactic magnetar FRB discovery.
The reviewer report does not flag any inconsistency in the baseline count (12 vs 11) or any numerical discrepancy in the baseline selection. Neither finding addresses this injection.
The review does not mention the baseline count, the inconsistency between 11 and 12, or the enumerated baselines in Methods. No specific numeric cross-section mismatch is identified.
The reviewer does not identify any numerical inconsistencies or mention the number of baselines selected (11 vs 12).
The reviewer report contains no mention of the beamforming equation, the sum-to-product operator swap, or any mathematical error in the beam signal definition.
There is no discussion of the beamforming equation, the definition of S, or an incorrect product versus summation operator. The mathematical operator swap is not flagged.
There is no mention of the beamforming equation or the substitution of the summation operator with a product operator.
The reviewer report does not flag the phantom-evidence parenthetical about phase stability in preliminary checks for the L>1.8m baseline cut. Neither finding corresponds to this injection.

This is too vague to count as detection of the phantom-evidence sub-claim.
